descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Siguranță publică
About the Role 
 * We are looking for a pragmatic Senior Developer who likes getting things done simply and efficiently.
 * No over-engineered microservices or overly complex setups here. We focus on writing clean, maintainable code, shipping features fast, and keeping our tech stack straightforward.
 Tech Stack 
 * Backend: Python / PostgreSQL
 * Frontend: TypeScript (Android/iOS App)
 * Secondary: Node.js (occasional services/tools)
 What You’ll Do 
 * Build and optimize backend features and REST APIs using Python.
 * Work directly with PostgreSQL (schema design, query optimization).
 * Connect the backend with our TypeScript frontend app.
 * Maintain occasional Node.js scripts or supporting components.
 * Keep the code clean, reliable, and easy to maintain.
 What We’re Looking For 
 * Strong experience with Python and backend development.
 * Good working knowledge of PostgreSQL.
 * Solid hands-on experience with TypeScript for the app layer.
 * A pragmatic approach: you prefer simple, working solutions over technical hype.
 * Fluent in English (written and spoken).
